data.name: Bhawesh
data.gender_notes: Bhawesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhawesh is a Sanskrit name derived from Bhagavan, which means 'Lord'. The suffix 'esh' adds the meaning 'Living'. Thus, Bhawesh translates to 'Lord of Living'. The name Bhawesh carries the meaning “Lord of Living” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhawesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of living and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion and surrender to the divine.
data.etymology: Bhawesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Living.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhawesh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
